summary: Largest US nuclear fleet, plus Calpine gas fleet (acquired 2026). Long-term nuclear PPAs with hyperscalers (Microsoft, Meta) give visible, inflation-linked earnings growth.

rationale.growthHigh: Calpine adds scale; nuclear contract re-pricing plus uprates give ~9% revenue growth.
rationale.targetMargin: Nuclear is high-margin, gas and retail lower; blended ~22%.
rationale.exitMultiple: 20x: scarce carbon-free baseload with 20-year contracts trades at a premium to other power producers.

thesis.text: Constellation is the largest US owner of nuclear plants, now also a major gas generator after buying Calpine. Long-term contracts with Microsoft and Meta show hyperscalers will pay a premium for carbon-free 24/7 power.
bull: Scarce carbon-free baseload; 20-year PPAs at premium prices
Calpine adds gas flexibility and Texas exposure
Nuclear tax credit gives a price floor
bear: Integration of Calpine and higher debt
Regulatory pushback on co-located data-centre deals
